qualifier: lipoxygenase/hepoxilin branch and inherited CYP and transporter defects
name: Lipoxygenase eicosanoid and fatty acid metabolism, inherited defects
rationale: Members cover fatty acid and eicosanoid synthesis and transport, with the 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin branch and inherited CYP, TBXAS1 and SLC transporter defects that the P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase confusables lack.

qualifier: Golgi trimming to complex and hybrid glycans with antenna elongation and sialylation
name: Golgi N-glycan maturation to complex and hybrid glycans
rationale: All members are Golgi steps of N-glycan maturation (mannose trimming, complex/hybrid branching, LacNAc elongation, sialylation), distinct from early ER N-glycan processing and O-glycan confusables.

core: Renal control of blood pressure and volume
qualifier: renin-angiotensin and natriuretic cGMP signalling
name: Renin-angiotensin and renal control of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members concern angiotensin generation and signalling, kinin catabolism, cGMP and renal sodium/urine/filtration control of blood pressure and volume, unlike the vasoconstriction and vasopressin water-reabsorption confusables.

qualifier: thyroid hormone and HPA glucocorticoid axes
name: Thyroid hormone and hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: Members center on thyroid hormone generation, transport and signalling plus ACTH-driven glucocorticoid secretion and response, distinguishing them from stress-behaviour, GH/prolactin and adrenal steroid-biosynthesis confusables.

qualifier: FLT3 and erythropoietin, with TKI-resistant FLT3 mutants
name: FLT3 and erythropoietin signaling, TKI-resistant FLT3 mutants
rationale: Members are FLT3 signalling, its CBL/STAT5/SRC regulation and drug-resistant FLT3 mutants plus EPO signalling, whereas confusables cover ALK, FGFR, PDGFR and KIT mutants.

qualifier: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and origin licensing
name: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and replication origin licensing
rationale: All members concern E2F target transcription and ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex licensing and initiation of DNA replication, which the generic cell-cycle and intra-S checkpoint confusables lack.

qualifier: naive, memory B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin
name: B cell and plasma cell surface and immunoglobulin signatures
rationale: Members are naive, memory B cell and plasma cell surface/immunoglobulin expression signatures and plasma cell differentiation, distinct from BCR signalling, germinal centre and T cell confusables.

qualifier: selective autophagy and aggresomes
name: Misfolded protein quality control via selective autophagy and aggresomes
rationale: Members cover misfolded protein handling through aggrephagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy and ERAD regulation, unlike the stress-granule, proteasomal and chaperonin-folding confusables.

qualifier: ligand-withdrawal via p75NTR and dependence receptors
name: Ligand-withdrawal neuronal apoptosis via p75NTR and dependence receptors
rationale: Members concern pro-death signalling in neurons by p75NTR and dependence receptors in absence of ligand plus FOXO death genes, whereas confusables cover p75NTR survival/processing and anoikis.

qualifier: mitotic and meiotic progression and chromosome segregation
name: Mitotic and meiotic cell cycle progression and chromosome segregation
rationale: The broad membership spans replication licensing, G2/M control, spindle, cohesion, cytokinesis and meiotic recombination, i.e. the whole mitotic and meiotic cycle, unlike the telomere and DNA-damage confusables.

qualifier: pesticides, dioxin, ethanol and nicotine
name: Response to organic xenobiotics: pesticides, dioxin, ethanol, nicotine
rationale: Members are responses to organic foreign chemicals (pesticides, dioxin/AhR, bisphenol A, ethanol, nicotine, anaesthetics), distinguishing them from metal-ion and vitamin confusables.

qualifier: crypt stem cell renewal and epithelial identity
name: Intestinal crypt stem cell renewal and epithelial identity
rationale: Members describe intestinal stem cell homeostasis, Wnt-maintained crypt epithelium and GI epithelial identity/barrier maintenance, unlike the HNF4-driven absorptive enterocyte and antimicrobial confusables.

core: Gap junction and surface channel regulation
qualifier: connexin trafficking and suppression of ion flux
name: Connexin gap junction trafficking and cell-surface ion channel regulation
rationale: Members cover connexin oligomerisation, trafficking and gap junction turnover plus regulation of surface protein localisation and ion channel activity, distinct from cardiac channel and nodal axon confusables.

qualifier: sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona pellucida binding
name: Sperm acrosome reaction and zona pellucida binding in fertilization
rationale: All members are sperm-egg interaction steps from capacitation and acrosome reaction to zona binding and egg activation, unlike the sperm motility and germline/zygote confusables.

name: Folate and tetrahydrofolate one-carbon metabolism
rationale: Members concern folate transport, response and tetrahydrofolate/formate one-carbon interconversion (with folate-linked neural tube closure), distinct from cobalamin, methionine and other vitamin confusables.

qualifier: AU-rich element-binding proteins
name: AU-rich element-binding protein control of mRNA stability
rationale: Members are 3'-UTR-binding proteins (TTP, AUF1, BRF1, KSRP, HuR) that destabilise or stabilise mRNA, unlike the miRNA, decapping and stress-granule confusables.

qualifier: lagging-strand polymerase switching and flap removal in replication, BER and telomeres
name: Lagging-strand DNA synthesis and flap removal in replication and repair
rationale: Members share primer synthesis, polymerase switching and flap removal in replication, long-patch base excision repair and telomere C-strand fill-in, unlike the translesion and NER gap-filling confusables.

qualifier: G-beta-gamma action on GIRK and calcium channels
name: G-beta-gamma presynaptic inhibition via GIRK and calcium channels
rationale: Members concern G-beta-gamma activation of GIRK channels, inhibition of voltage-gated Ca2+ channels and presynaptic kainate control of membrane potential, unlike confusables on vesicle exocytosis and transmitter secretion.

qualifier: RUNX transcriptional control and G-CSF signalling
name: RUNX-regulated granulocyte differentiation and G-CSF signaling
rationale: Members concern RUNX-family and myeloid transcriptional control of granulopoiesis with G-CSF signalling and neutrophil/eosinophil differentiation, unlike the macrophage/monocyte and progenitor confusables.

qualifier: viral budding, exosomes, abscission and nuclear envelope sealing
name: ESCRT-III membrane fission in budding, abscission and nuclear sealing
rationale: All members use ESCRT-mediated membrane scission, for MVB/exosome formation, viral budding, midbody abscission and nuclear envelope resealing, unlike endocytic and cytokinesis confusables.

qualifier: Th2-driven IL-5 production and eosinophil recruitment
name: Th2-driven IL-5 production and eosinophil recruitment and activation
rationale: Members link Th2 differentiation and IL-5 production to eosinophil chemotaxis, activation and effector function, unlike the IL-4/IL-13 signalling and granulocyte differentiation confusables.

qualifier: ventricular myocardium and septum
name: Ventricular myocardium and cardiac septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern morphogenesis of ventricular trabecular and compact myocardium and the membranous and muscular septum, which the early cardiogenesis and cardiomyocyte proliferation confusables lack.

qualifier: oncogene/stress induction and its evasion via p16INK4A/p14ARF defects
name: Oncogene- and stress-induced cellular senescence and its evasion
rationale: Members cover oncogene, oxidative and replicative senescence with SASP, SAHF, p53/p21 and Polycomb control and cancer evasion via p16INK4A/p14ARF defects, unlike p53 apoptosis and DNA-damage checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: mature spliced, intronless and histone mRNAs
name: Nuclear export of mature mRNA
rationale: All members are export of mature mRNAs from the nucleus, unlike confusables on protein import, nuclear pore assembly and mRNA 3'-end processing.

qualifier: herpes simplex encephalitis
name: TLR3-TRIF pathway deficiencies in herpes simplex encephalitis
rationale: All members are inherited TLR3, TRIF (TICAM1) or TRAF3 deficiencies causing herpes simplex encephalitis, unlike confusables on TLR7/8/9, TAK1 activation and IRF3 interferon induction.
